description: Which box of the phone's cycle packs to read for the fields round the airplane with no planner (Nearest, the emergency assistant, the on-device Ask), for best_fields to rank: asked first with no box, the first box, half a degree of latitude each way (about 30 nm, past a light single's still-air glide from 10,000 ft above the ground); asked again with the fields found in it, a box twice as tall where they are fewer than `want`, to two degrees at most (about 120 nm); null where they are enough or the box read was the widest, when the fields read go to best_fields. Longitude is widened by the latitude's cosine (held to 0.2 at most near the pole). A box to read, not an aviation figure: which fields are landing sites, and their order, are best_fields'.

want.description: How many fields are wanted: the box widens until it holds as many.

half_deg.description: The box last read, its `half_deg` as this rule gave it; null on the first ask.

found.description: How many fields the packs held in that box; null on the first ask.

box.description: The box to read next, degrees; null: rank the fields read with best_fields.

half_deg.description: Its half height, degrees of latitude: sent back as `half_deg`.
